rules.rationale: Source: long SMILES strongly lowered solubility; by the general solubility equation that bulk raises octanol partitioning.
Source: short SMILES were most soluble. Small solutes expose little apolar surface, depressing logD.
Highest-weight source role was ring structure. Rigid fused rings add apolar, low-entropy surface favoring octanol.
Heteroatom-poor hydrocarbon skeletons are the classic high-logP regime; broader coverage than the prior length interaction.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers the strongest ESOL roles (size, rings) with inverted sign plus a carbon-rich core term. Fails if pool variance comes from ionization or polar functional groups rather than molecular bulk.

rules.rationale: Aromatic carbon surface partitions favorably into octanol and dominates high-lipophilicity medicinal chemistry space.
Ring-dense scaffolds add rigid apolar surface; mirrors the highest-confidence source role without relying on length bins.
Counter-hypothesis reversing the uncertain rotatable-bond-to-branch role: heavy branching usually marks polar solubilizing side chains.
Moderate halogenation of aromatic rings adds positive Hansch pi surface; broader, less brittle than the rare halogen_high bin.

skills.hypothesis: Tests whether aromatic and ring surface, minus branching flexibility, beats size-driven transfer, while reversing the weak branch role. Fails if branching tracks apolar alkyl chains rather than polar substituents.

state.lesson: Development seeds favored the inverted ESOL bulk/ring transfer (mean AUC 87.9) over the halogen-centric partition skill (85.2), and the latter's per-seed spread was wide (80.3-93.7). Narrow bins such as halogen_high (98 of 4200) and strong negative penalties on the majority hetero_high bin appear to waste budget; broad bulk and ring terms with a modest carbon-rich bonus are steadier. Seed counts are small, so this is a preference, not proof of mechanism.
state.revision_summary: Retained the better-performing source-grounded skill largely intact, replacing its narrow hetero_low x smiles_long interaction with a single hetero_low term for wider coverage, and easing semantic mass decay slightly. Rebuilt the alternative as a cleaner counter-hypothesis: it drops the aggressive hetero_high penalty and the rare halogen_high rule that coincided with the weaker run, keeps aromatic and ring surface as the mechanistic core, and reverses the low-confidence rotatable-bond-to-branch source role as a negative branching term. Deployment is frozen on the inverted bulk/ring transfer.
